claim_text: This cell is limited to exogenous wildfire attack on wind-farm equipment; equipment-origin, electrical, lightning, maintenance, and other endogenous fires are not substitute calibration cases.
permitted_inference: Use internal-fire evidence only for anatomy, propagation, and post-ignition disposition context.
prohibited_inference: Estimate external-wildfire ignition probability or DR from endogenous fire incidents.
reasoning: Cause, delivered load, population, and initiating location differ even when later damage zones overlap.
update_trigger: A reviewed transfer study proves exact equivalence for a named post-ignition state.

claim_text: Thermal attack, firebrand ignition, and destructive residue contamination are separate pathways and must not silently share one response.
permitted_inference: Preserve one event family while modeling each causal pathway separately.
prohibited_inference: Collapse radiation, convection, flame contact, firebrand ingress, and residue into one generic wildfire severity curve.
reasoning: The demand variables, target interactions, and evidence endpoints differ.
update_trigger: A governed pathway redesign with demonstrated equivalence passes review.

claim_text: FSim burn probability and six conditional flame-length probability classes are source-hazard fields at 270 m support.
exact_locator: metadata identification and conditional FLP attributes
permitted_inference: Capture exact product/version, spatial support, burn probability, and the six conditional classes.
prohibited_inference: Create unreported class midpoints or treat the fields as equipment load, exposure fraction, or damage probability.
reasoning: Source-native hazard semantics must survive before any asset bridge.
update_trigger: USFS changes the product definition or a new governed product is adopted.

claim_text: Fireline intensity in kW/m and FSim flame-length classes are not delivered equipment heat flux in kW/m2.
exact_locator: FSim attributes; FARSITE definition; field-heating results
permitted_inference: Use these fields as upstream fire-behavior inputs to a separately validated local-attack bridge.
prohibited_inference: Apply a fixed-distance scalar, height attenuation, or direct curve lookup to equipment.
reasoning: Landscape propagation quantities omit target geometry, distance, view, shielding, flame contact, gas state, and time history.
update_trigger: A versioned bridge with validation, uncertainty, and KATs passes.

claim_text: Delivered thermal attack requires time-resolved radiant and convective heating, duration, and where relevant direct flame contact and gas state.
permitted_inference: Define future local demand as explicit radiation, convection, flame-contact, duration, temperature, and velocity fields.
prohibited_inference: Represent all thermal attacks by one peak or universal attenuation factor.
reasoning: Short peaks and sustained heating can differ materially and are fuel/environment dependent.
update_trigger: A validated reduced-order demand object proves sufficiency.

claim_text: Firebrand attack requires particle size or mass, combustion state, flux or count, deposition or accumulation, ingress, substrate/contact, wind, and time.
permitted_inference: Specify a future deposition/ingress/contact history at the receiving equipment zone.
prohibited_inference: Use flame length, one particle peak flux, or generic ember presence as ignition probability or DR.
reasoning: Individual and accumulated firebrands have distinct load variables and do not establish target-equipment response.
update_trigger: A target-equipment bridge and population response qualify.

claim_text: Residue belongs in this physical-destruction cell only when it causes an inspected conductive, corrosive, or otherwise destructive equipment disposition.
permitted_inference: Capture residue composition, dose, wetness/conductivity, penetration, corrosion, and inspected disposition.
prohibited_inference: Treat smoke presence, soot, odor, generic ash fouling, cleaning, derating, or downtime as physical DR.
reasoning: The repository ordinate is direct repair/replacement cost for physical destruction, not disruption or ordinary cleaning.
update_trigger: A source-backed destructive residue state/cost chain is reviewed.

claim_text: Blade-material tests establish combustible-matrix mechanisms and relevant flux/time/selectors but not full-blade economic vulnerability.
permitted_inference: Use resin/construction, incident flux, duration, and specimen endpoint to design future tests.
prohibited_inference: Transfer specimen ignition, heat release, or smoke results to full-blade state probabilities, structural disposition, or cost.
reasoning: Specimen scale, loading protocol, field attack, structural assembly, and economic endpoint are unmatched.
update_trigger: Representative full-scale or validated scaling plus disposition/cost evidence passes.

claim_text: Wind turbines contain physically distinct rotor, nacelle, tower, base, cable/power-takeoff, and protection zones whose fire damage can propagate dependently.
exact_locator: technical-assessment anatomy and named post-fire component disposition
permitted_inference: Use zone observations to define one dependency-safe turbine assembly state system.
prohibited_inference: Assign independent additive terminal losses to overlapping blade, nacelle, and upper-tower scopes.
reasoning: Ignition in one zone can produce overlapping downstream repair/replacement scopes.
update_trigger: A finer source-backed denominator and mutually exclusive state system is approved.

claim_text: Internal/lightning/electrical wind-turbine fires are adjacent disposition evidence, not exogenous-wildfire calibration.
exact_locator: incident tables and operator event summary
permitted_inference: Use named damaged components and propagation sequences as pressure-test context.
prohibited_inference: Infer external attack, ignition probability, event severity, or representative cost.
reasoning: The initiating cause and delivered load are absent or different.
update_trigger: A causal transfer study establishes a common post-ignition state conditional on the same local state.

permitted_inference: Retain onshore spatial subjects, flame/radiant/debris fields, controls, and the explicit unknown endpoint.
prohibited_inference: Infer a numerical loss, representative exposure fraction, or survival credit.
reasoning: The closest direct onshore source does not supply response or cost.
update_trigger: A matched onshore event/inspection/cost record is captured.

claim_text: AFAC, CFA, and FM guidance identify site planning, access, water, vegetation, separation, shutdown, containment, and protection fields but do not quantify universal damage credits.
exact_locator: planning, preparedness, vegetation, containment, and protection sections
permitted_inference: Capture exact jurisdiction, edition, design, installed state, maintenance, availability, and event evidence.
prohibited_inference: Apply compliance, clearance, water, access, or protection as a generic DR multiplier or proof of survival.
reasoning: Guidance establishes auditable controls, not population efficacy under wildfire attack.
update_trigger: Matched loss data or controlled tests quantify a named control and validity domain.

claim_text: DNV fire-protection certification is an applicability selector and evidence field, not a wildfire efficacy coefficient.
permitted_inference: Capture system identity, certificate/edition, installed/available/maintained state, and protected zones.
prohibited_inference: Assume suppression success, automatic loss reduction, or equivalence across systems.
reasoning: Certification scope does not provide wildfire-conditioned response probability.
update_trigger: Product/system-specific wildfire efficacy evidence qualifies.

claim_text: NEMA guidance supports post-fire evaluate, replace, or recondition disposition labels for electrical equipment, not pre-event fragility or cost.
permitted_inference: Design inspected switchgear, transformer, cable, electronics, battery, and residue states.
prohibited_inference: Assign disposition probability, attack threshold, repair ratio, or cost from the guidance.
reasoning: A disposition protocol is not a hazard-conditioned curve.
update_trigger: Matched wildfire inspections and same-unit invoices become available.
